armada-main.title: Test Campaign 1 - Armada
armada-main.description: This campaign has Mission API test missions, for now.
markers_test.description: Tests adding and removing markers, and drawing lines.
markers_test.title: Markers Test
sound_test.description: Tests playing sounds at positions, and queuing sounds pausing the normal sound notifications.
sound_test.title: Sound Test
unit_triggers_test.description: Tests unit related triggers and actions, such as dwelling, entering locations, being resurrected, etc.
unit_triggers_test.title: Unit Triggers Test
validation_test.description: Tests invalid mission scripts, e.g. parameter values, etc. All possible validation errors should be present in the log.
validation_test.title: Validation Test
test_mission.description: Tests various actions and triggers, a left over from before tests were added separately for different parts of the API.
test_mission.title: Test Mission
issue_orders_test.description: Tests issuing orders to units, including by unit name, and area attacking.
issue_orders_test.title: IssueOrders Test
feature_triggers_test.description: Tests triggers related to features, including creation, destruction, reclamation, and resurrection.
feature_triggers_test.title: Feature Triggers Test
statistics_triggers_test.description: Tests triggers related to unit statistics: TotalUnitsKilled, TotalUnitsLost, TotalUnitsCaptured, TotalUnitsBuilt, and UnitsOwned.
statistics_triggers_test.title: Statistics Triggers Test
resource_test.description: Tests triggers and action related to resources, including adding resources, and triggers for stored resources, income, and pull.
resource_test.title: Resource Test
loadout_test.description: Tests pre-spawning units and features via UnitLoadout and FeatureLoadout, and the actions SpawnUnits and CreateFeatures.
loadout_test.title: Loadout Test
stages_and_objectives_test.title: Stages and Objectives Test
unit_mover_test.description: Tests the MoveUnits action: teleporting a unit with no direction, with a look-at direction, and with a compass angle.
unit_mover_test.title: Unit Mover Test
unit_detection_test.description: Tests UnitDetected and UnitUndetected across every sensor level and filter.
unit_detection_test.title: Unit Detection Test
unit_received_order_test.description: Tests triggers that fire when units receive orders: UnitOrdered, RallyOrdered.
unit_received_order_test.title: Unit Received Order Test
pause_test.description: Tests the Pause and Unpause actions: the pause screen stays hidden and the pause key cannot end a scripted pause.
pause_test.title: Pause Test
transport_loaded_test.description: Tests the TransportLoaded and TransportUnloaded triggers, which watch the transport rather than its passenger.
transport_loaded_test.title: TransportLoaded Test
unit_loaded_test.description: Tests the UnitLoaded and UnitUnloaded triggers, which watch the passenger rather than its transport.
unit_loaded_test.title: UnitLoaded Test
unit_received_test.description: Tests the UnitReceived and UnitCaptured triggers, and the TransferUnits action's captured flag.
unit_received_test.title: UnitReceived Test
countdowns_test.description: Tests the countdown actions and the CountdownReached and CountdownFinished triggers, including pausing, cancelling and adjusting a countdown.
countdowns_test.title: Countdowns Test
